title: 国家互联网信息办公室关于《人工智能生成合成内容标识办法（征求意见稿）》公开征求意见的通知

policy_extraction.issuing_body: Cyberspace Administration of China (国家互联网信息办公室)
covered_actors: Network information service providers subject to the Algorithm Recommendation, Deep Synthesis, and Generative AI Interim Measures that provide services to the domestic public
Network information content dissemination platform service providers
Users uploading AI-generated or synthetic content to dissemination platforms
Any organization or individual (with respect to prohibitions on tampering with or forging labels)
prohibited_practices: Maliciously deleting, tampering with, forging, or concealing required AI-generated or synthetic content labels
Providing tools or services to others to maliciously delete, tamper with, forge, or conceal required labels
Harming the legitimate rights and interests of others through improper labeling means

evidence.quote: 服务提供者提供生成合成内容下载、复制、导出等方式时，应当确保文件中含有满足要求的显式标识。
evidence.quote_en: When service providers offer methods such as downloading, copying, or exporting generated or synthesized content, they shall ensure that the files contain explicit labels meeting the requirements.

evidence.quote: （四）对于确为、可能和疑似生成合成内容的，应当在文件元数据中添加生成合成内容属性信息、传播平台名称或编码、内容编号等传播要素信息；
evidence.quote_en: (4) For content confirmed, likely, or suspected to be generated or synthesized, dissemination element information such as attribute information of the generated or synthesized content, the name or code of the dissemination platform, and the content identifier shall be added to the file metadata;

evidence.quote: 国家互联网信息办公室起草了《人工智能生成合成内容标识办法（征求意见稿）》，现向社会公开征求意见。
evidence.source_section: 国家互联网信息办公室关于《人工智能生成合成内容标识办法（征求意见稿）》公开征求意见的通知
evidence.quote_en: The Cyberspace Administration of China has drafted the Measures for Labeling AI-Generated and Synthesized Content (Draft for Comment) and is now soliciting public comments.

enforcement_authorities: Cyberspace Administration of China (国家互联网信息办公室)
policy_extraction.implementation_notes: This document is a public consultation notice and un-enacted draft departmental regulation (征求意见稿) issued by the Cyberspace Administration of China (CAC) on 2024-09-14, so it is coded as regulatory_guidance rather than binding_law. It exempts industry organizations, enterprises, educational/research institutions, public cultural institutions, and professional institutions that develop or apply AI-generated/synthetic content technologies without providing services to the domestic public. The provided text contains Articles 1–6, 10, and 14 (omitting Articles 7–9 and 11–13), and Article 14 leaves the exact 2024 effective date blank.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The draft measures are primarily framed around social stability and online information-ecosystem governance: both the public consultation notice and Article 1 invoke safeguarding 'social public interest' (维护社会公共利益), and the operative structure centers on regulating the labeling and dissemination of AI-generated synthetic content across online platforms to prevent malicious forgery, tampering, or concealment. Social stability edges out fundamental rights because, although the text repeatedly cites protecting the 'legitimate rights and interests of citizens, legal persons, and other organizations' (保护公民、法人和其他组织合法权益), its core governance mechanism is collective information-ecosystem order rather than individual constitutional or privacy rights. Innovation enablement appears explicitly in Article 1's goal of promoting the 'healthy development of AI' alongside an R&D carve-out for non-public services; national security is explicitly invoked in the consultation notice; and consumer/public safety is reflected in mandatory prominent notices reminding users when content is synthetic to prevent deception.

evidence_spans.quote: 为规范人工智能生成合成内容标识，维护国家安全和社会公共利益，保护公民、法人和其他组织的合法权益
evidence_spans.source_section: 国家互联网信息办公室关于《人工智能生成合成内容标识办法（征求意见稿）》公开征求意见的通知
evidence_spans.quote_en: In order to regulate the labeling of AI-generated and synthetic content, safeguard national security and the social public interest, and protect the legitimate rights and interests of citizens, legal persons, and other organizations

evidence_spans.quote: （一）应当核验文件元数据中是否含有隐式标识，对于含有隐式标识的，应当采取适当方式在发布内容周边添加显著的提示标识，明确提醒用户该内容属于生成合成内容；
evidence_spans.quote_en: (1) Shall verify whether the file metadata contains implicit labels; for content containing implicit labels, shall adopt appropriate methods to add prominent prompt labels around the published content to clearly remind users that the content is generated or synthesized content;

evidence_spans.quote: 任何组织和个人不得恶意删除、篡改、伪造、隐匿本办法规定的生成合成内容标识，不得为他人实施上述恶意行为提供工具或服务，不得通过不正当标识手段损害他人合法权益。
evidence_spans.quote_en: No organization or individual may maliciously delete, tamper with, forge, or conceal the labels for generated and synthetic content prescribed by these Measures, nor provide tools or services for others to carry out such malicious acts, nor harm the legitimate rights and interests of others through improper labeling means.
